title: Cricket World Cup
metaDescription: The Cricket World Cup is the international one-day championship contested by national teams

overview.about: The Cricket World Cup is the pinnacle of one-day international cricket, held every four years and one of the most-watched sporting events on earth thanks to its vast following across South Asia, Australia and England. Australia are the dominant force with six titles. The 2027 tournament is co-hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia from October to December.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Cricket World Cup runs from October to December, co-hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia. Fourteen teams contest the 50-over tournament, with the host nations' grounds staging matches through to the final.
